exec git init -b main
env TZ=UTC
at 2026-07-28T12:00:00Z
exec card init --prefix key-
exec card config set --scope store issue.id.strategy sequential

exec card create --key source:z 'First issue'
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/create-first.txt
! exec card create --key= 'Empty key'
cmp stderr $WORK/golden/empty-key.txt
! exec card edit key-1 --key=
cmp stderr $WORK/golden/empty-key.txt
exec card edit key-1 --key source:a
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/edit-first.txt
exec card edit key-1 --key source:a
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/edit-first.txt

exec card create --key source:other 'Second issue'
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/create-second.txt
! exec card edit key-2 --key source:a
cmp stderr $WORK/golden/key-conflict.txt
! exec card create --key source:a 'Rejected issue'
cmp stderr $WORK/golden/key-conflict.txt

exec card create 'Third issue'
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/create-third.txt

exec card --json show --key source:z
cmpjson stdout $WORK/golden/show.json
exec card show --key source:a
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/show.txt

-- golden/create-first.txt --
key-1
-- golden/edit-first.txt --
edited key-1
-- golden/create-second.txt --
key-2
-- golden/create-third.txt --
key-3
-- golden/key-conflict.txt --
error: external key "source:a" belongs to issue "key-1"
-- golden/empty-key.txt --
error: invalid input: external key required
-- golden/show.json --
